critical_code_review_comments: OdometerValue component is well-implemented with slot-machine style animation
Component uses aria-label for accessibility with the full value string
SlotDigit renders all digits 0-9 in a column and animates translateY to show target digit
StaticChar handles non-digit characters ($ € , .) with fade-in animation
Stagger delay (staggerMs prop) creates cascading animation effect across digits
Component properly handles various number formats: currency ($150,000.00), percentages (57.1%), integers (17,681)
context_for_next_testing_agent: OdometerValue component fully tested and working across 12 files. Key implementation: 1) OdometerValue.jsx in /app/frontend/src/components/dashboard/ renders slot-machine style digit animation. 2) Each digit slides from 0 to target value with staggered delays. 3) Non-digit characters ($ € , .) fade in. 4) Animation duration ~1.2-1.4 seconds. 5) Component accepts 'value' (string), 'staggerMs' (delay between digits), 'duration' (animation time) props. 6) Used in BalanceCard, DashboardPage, AccountsPage, CryptoMarketPage, BitcoinOutputsPage, InvestmentSimulatorPage, PortfolioPage, TransactionChart, AdminDashboardPage, AdminTreasuryPage.
